package.description: Private, offline speech-to-text and dictation for Windows, powered by the open-source OpenASR engine -- no cloud, no telemetry, fully local.

en-US.description: Private, offline speech-to-text and dictation for Windows, powered by the open-source OpenASR engine -- no cloud, no telemetry, fully local.
en-US.longDescription: OpenASR Desktop brings system-wide dictation and audio/meeting transcription to Windows, running entirely on-device on top of the Apache-2.0 OpenASR speech-recognition engine (ggml-backed, eleven model families, CPU and GPU inference). Nothing is uploaded: no cloud fallback, no telemetry, no account required. Models are downloaded once from a signed catalog and then run fully offline.
en-US.name: OpenASR Desktop
